title: Zero entropy does not guarantee a smooth positive-volume model

result.label: Zero entropy does not guarantee a smooth positive-volume model
result.statement: Constructs a zero-entropy ergodic invertible transformation of a standard nonatomic probability space that is not measurably conjugate to any C ∞ diffeomorphism preserving a strictly positive smooth probability density on a compact finite-dimensional manifold. One example rules out every finite dimension.
